Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the department of natural resources to offer nominally valuable materials to nonprofit organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing the department of natural resources toprovide nonprofit organizations with nominally valuable materials; andamending RCW 79.15.050.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79.15.050 and 2006 c 42 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All sales of valuable materials exceeding twentyfive thousanddollars in appraised value must be at public auction or by sealed bidto the highest bidder, provided that on public lands granted to thestate for educational purposes sealed bids may be accepted for sales oftimber or stone only. (2)(a) A direct sale of valuable materials may be sold to theapplicant for cash at full appraised value without notice oradvertising. (b) Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the boardmust, by resolution, establish the value amount of a direct sale not toexceed twentyfive thousand dollars in appraised sale value, andestablish procedures to ensure that competitive market prices andaccountability are guaranteed. p. 1 SHB 1879 (c) The department may offer fallen woody debris, boulders, andother materials in a direct sale, without going to public auction, foruse in publicly funded aquatic habitat improvement projects. Thedepartment must ensure that in all direct sales to organizations underthis subsection that it receives compensation at the appraised value,if any, for the sold materials.
